name: plan-first-marketplace
description: Marketplace hosting the plan-first Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: plan-first
plugins.description: PRD-first development workflow with testing built in: PRDs, a pre-plan architecture discussion that settles design decisions before phasing, phased plans (tests ship per phase), multi-lens plan reviews (clarifying-questions, deep-critique, and adversarial red-team passes), a docs-first research sub-agent, implementation tracking, Playwright e2e tests via bundled MCP, code reviews with up to 7 reviewers with a test-execution pass, tradeoff decisions, and doc audits.
